title: PIIInstrument
description: A PII instrument containing a token from a trusted PII provider. Mirrors PaymentInstrument — the agent never sees raw PII, only this token-based reference.

credential.description: Token credential from the PII provider.

fields_stored.description: PII field names available via this token.

loan_type.description: Loan type this PII profile covers.

platform_id.description: Platform this token was minted for. Each lender gets a separate token.
